Marissa / team / Elaine — attached is the modeling workbook (zenpath_token_modeling.xlsx) and a 2-page commit phasing PDF. Summary below. Numbers are conservative and assume: prefix/KV caching on common prompts, continuous batching at 8-12ms inter-arrival, and quantized kernels for the 13B variant.

Assumptions:
- Business hours (12h): 300k tokens/hour baseline => 83.33 tokens/sec sustained
- Burst events: up to 1.2M tokens/hour => 333.33 tokens/sec sustained over short windows (hour-level)
- Average response length: 48 tokens per request
- Concurrent request shape: median 20 req/s, burst 80 req/s during events

Model performance (observed on our runtime):
- Redwood-13B-quant (int8-ish profile) => ~320 tokens/sec per A100-80GB equiv (continuous, chat context 1024)
- Redwood-13B-quant on L40 => ~260 tokens/sec
- Redwood-70B-fp16 => ~95 tokens/sec per H100-80GB equiv (higher memory, more seq compute)

Sizing calc (target p95 <= 900ms):
- Baseline tokens/sec need = 83.33 tps -> fits on 1x A100 running 13B with ~3x headroom for quiet hours multiplier 3.0 (we recommend smaller quiet-hour multiplier but using 3.0 to be safe)
- Burst tokens/sec need = 333.33 tps -> with 13B-quant, that is ~1.04 A100 equivalents per 320 tps; add burst safety margin 1.5x => 1.56 -> round to 2 GPUs.

Phase recommendation (dedicated slab mapping):
- Pilot (month 0-3): 1x A100-equivalent dedicated for Redwood-13B-quant. Provides p95 ~700ms expected. Cache warm-up window critical.
- Initial commit (month 3-9): 2x A100-equivalent (primary) + 1x H100-equivalent as overflow for selective 70B workloads. Headroom designed for 1.8x sustained business-hour multiplier and 2.5x burst tolerance.
- Scale (month 9-12): 4x A100-equivalent + 2x H100-equivalent; enables sustained growth to ~1.6M tokens/hour with p95 <= 900ms and 2.0x burst headroom.

Cost/ops notes:
- Mixed GPU fleet reduces unit cost: prefer 13B quant on A100s/L40s for most traffic and reserve H100s for high-quality 70B tails.
- Auto-fallback policy: if H100 capacity constrained, fall back to 13B with adjusted prompt truncation and provide quality delta telemetry to Zenpath.
- Cache warming: pre-warm KV cache for top 50 intents before major product releases to avoid first-hour spikes.

Attachments: zenpath_token_modeling.xlsx (sheets: traffic_histogram, gpu_perf, phase_calc) and commit_phasing_v1.pdf. I put the workbook numbers in the traffic_histogram tab — ask if you want the raw samples.
